During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a famous [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] '''warrior''' sought help in identifying a [[Unidentified Mandalorian warrior's opponent|masked opponent]] that he fought to a draw on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mimban/Legends|Circarpous V]] so that he could battle them again.<ref name="TOR" />
